# Examples

## Quick targeted assessment

`evaluate change request effort for x-ipe-docs/cr-cases/CR-2026-014 with evaluate-change-request-efforts skill --analysis-depth quick`

Inspect target modules and immediate tests, then publish all reports with narrow coverage stated explicitly.

## Standard Vendor comparison

Assess dependencies, integrations, data and regression impact. If Vendor totals align, say so; do not force an overestimate conclusion.

## Qualified Deep assessment

When a generated subsystem or inaccessible dependency prevents full traversal, retain `deep` as requested, record the gap and needed evidence, lower affected confidence, and publish a qualified result.
